_readme: What `weapon_size_steps` in the payload MEANS. The backend does not scale damage dice -- it emits a size marker and the consumers scale (ruling 2026-08-17: the web sheet pre-scales, the FoundryVTT module's createScalingAttackItem does its own). This file is the shared definition of a 'step', so the three of them cannot drift, and Backend/scripts/gates/validate_gear_legality.py checks its shape and its ordering.
authority: HOUSE RULE, not RAW. The live implementation is the `Base_Weapon_Damage_Dice.JS` hook in FoundryVTT/Data/Foundry_VTT_Pf_1e_Handy_Macros, which reads the actor resource `sizefordamage` and scales every damage formula through the ladder below. The ladder is transcribed from that macro on 2026-08-17 IN ITS OWN ORDER; the macro is the source and this is the copy.
known_inversions: The macro's ladder is not perfectly sorted by average, and this copy reproduces that faithfully rather than tidying it -- because the macro steps a size category by moving TWO POSITIONS, so re-sorting here would silently make this file disagree with the thing it is copying. Two pairs are out of order: 8d6 (28) sits above 5d10 (27.5), and 16d6 (56) above 10d10 (55). Each costs at most half a point of average damage on one step and neither breaks the progression. The gate WARNS about them on every run rather than failing, so they stay visible until Daniel rules on whether to reorder the macro. Fix the macro first if so, then re-transcribe.

how_a_step_works.rule: One size category = TWO positions along `ladder`. A die not on the ladder is first snapped to the nearest entry by average, which is how the macro handles conditional and homebrew formulas.
how_a_step_works.clamps: Below the first entry stays at the first; past the last stays at the last.

attack_penalty_rule: A creature can't make optimum use of a weapon that isn't properly sized for it. A cumulative -2 penalty applies on attack rolls for each size category of difference. (Core Rulebook, quoted verbatim. Unlike the damage ladder this is RAW and unmodified.)

raw_reference._note: Core Rulebook Table 6-5, transcribed 2026-08-17 and verified row-for-row against aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=110 and roll20.net/compendium/pathfinder/Weapons, which agree exactly. Kept because it is what a player will expect, and because the house ladder DELIBERATELY diverges from it -- RAW steps 1d8 to 2d6 and 1d6 to 1d8, where the ladder steps them to 1d12 and 1d10. Nothing reads this; it is here so the divergence is a recorded decision rather than a discrepancy somebody rediscovers.
raw_reference._also: PF1e never published a Huge-or-larger weapon damage table at all, which is why RAW cannot answer a Medium wielder at +2 steps and the house ladder can.
